title: 30A Beach House 30A Wonderland at Treetop Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A pet friendly beach house rental, 30A Wonderland at Treetop, located in Seacrest Beach, FL is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home. This home is within the 30A gated community of Treetop Village. 4 Bikes included with your stay.
description_expanded: Description Description 30A pet friendly beach house rental, 30A Wonderland at Treetop, located in Seacrest Beach, FL is a 5 bedroom, 4.5 bathroom vacation home. This home is within the 30A gated community of Treetop Village. 4 Bikes included with your stay. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! This home features gorgeous furnishings throughout with detailed woodwork, shiplap, hardwood floors, quartz counters, 2 master suites, spacious covered decks and lush landscaping offering additional privacy for guests. Guests also love the outdoor fire pit, foosball table, and cornhole game during their stay. Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 5 Bedrooms, 4.5 Bathroom* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bath - 1st Floor* Bedroom 2 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - 2nd Floor* Bedroom 3 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - 2nd Floor* Bedroom 4 - 2 Bunk Beds - 2 Full over Full - 2nd Floor* Bathroom 4 - Tub/Shower Combo* Bedroom 5 - King Bed, Smart TV, En Suite Bathroom - 3rd Floor* Living Area - Large Smart TV* Fully Equipped Kitchen with Breakfast Bar* Dining Area * Living Area - 2 Queen and 1 Twin Sleeper Sofas* Half Bathroom on Main Level* Covered Decks * Foosball Table - Second Balcony* Back Patio with Seating and Gas Grill* Outdoor Shower* Screened in Deck - TV, Games, Seating * Indoor Gas Fireplace* Outdoor Fire Pit - Side Balcony * Childrens Play Area * Games - Books, Legos, Uno, Mancala, Trivial Pursuit.* 4 Parking Spaces Only - Strictly Enforced* FREE High Speed WI-FI* Sleeps 21 30A Beach Access Points ABOUT TREETOP VILLAGE IN SEACREST, FL This gated Seacrest community is nestled between Alys and Rosemary Beach offering a prime 30A location. The community includes easy access with 2 private entrances off 30A and Hwy 98. Guests will enjoy being within walking distance to all the shops and restaurants at Seacrest, Alys and Rosemary Beach. COMMUNITY AMENITIESPOOLWALK TO RESTAURANTS AND SHOPS BONUS ***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar and body wash. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom & one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens & towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
